goal: Define release-grade external value reproduction evidence package.
risk: AOF may overclaim that a reproduction package proves completed external validation.
loss_boundary: Do not call v10.4 complete if it implies completed external reproduction, market proof, or third-party validation completion.
evidence_plan: release docs, capability delta, requirement coverage, work execution packet, Council review, runtime audits
stop_conditions: Stop if live provider execution is implied
Stop if production safety is claimed from structural evidence alone
